checks.reason: The defect was measured on both platforms with different git versions deleting different refs, and no capture this register reads runs Windows git, so the Windows half is a recorded Windows-native run (R207).

An Install whose https URL the user's config rewrites to a path, or to ssh, fails network, and a marker GIT_SSH_COMMAND never runs. On a2fc935 the same Install clones over the rewritten transport.
